perspectives.author: matt
perspectives.interpretation: Could have led to the creation of Q Club - they may have profiled me and created clubs to observe/engage

perspectives.author: matt
perspectives.interpretation: Investor/business perspective - clubs created based on profiling of potential high-value individuals

perspectives.author: ai
perspectives.interpretation: Rideshare/lift home from club is normal. New clubs opening in entertainment districts is common. Logo similarities could be coincidental - Q is a common letter for nightlife branding.

perspectives.author: ai
perspectives.interpretation: No clear government interest in club creation based on individual profiling.

notes: Timing relative to Q Bar and other club openings is significant
Q Bar logo similar to narrator's company logo

uncategorizedEvents.title: Chase Credit Check Emails
uncategorizedEvents.summary: Chase sends credit check emails despite no account and no easy removal option.
uncategorizedEvents.description: Chase still sends me emails about credit checks even though I have no account there and have no easy way to remove it. This shouldn't be possible and represents a security/privacy concern.

perspectives.author: ai
perspectives.interpretation: Shouldn't be allowed to keep scanning my credit when my account is closed. At minimum should be able to easily prevent this somehow.
